sentences.text: The learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that though the offences involved are serious in nature a bare reading of the allegations which has been registered in the form of a complaint would show that the same are concocted.
He has highlighted the aspect that though the alleged incident is on 04.06.2024, the complaint has been lodged on 27.08.2024.

On the other hand, resisting the prayer for interim bail, Shri Das, the learned Addl. PP, Assam has submitted that in the complaint itself necessary explanations have been given as to why the delay has occurred.

On consideration of the rival submissions on the aspect of the prayer for interim protection, this Court is of the opinion that interest of justice would be served if an order of interim protection is passed in the meantime.

After hearing the learned counsel for the parties, in the interim, it is directed that till the next date,
in the event of arrest of the abovenamed applicant in connection with the aforementioned police case, he shall be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- with one surety of the like amount subject to the satisfaction of the Arresting Authority.
The applicant is also directed to appear before the concerned Police Station/IO on or before 18.11.2024 for recording his statement.
The applicant is further directed to render full cooperation in the investigation of the case and not to indulge in any activities detrimental to the same.
